title: collector-inputs v1: the body of POST /v1/complete
description: The build's result, as a relay sends it (COLLIN-23, COLLIN-32). A collector ignores a member whose name is none of the three in any case of its letters.

exit_code.description: The build's exit code: 0 is success. A relay writes it with no fraction and no exponent (COLLIN-23).

message.description: Text for a person about the build's end; may be empty.

error.description: Text for a person about a failure of the build's run; may be empty.
